amendments: construction-amendments.json records A001 before this freeze
candidate: One validated immutable 0.4.0rc4 artifact identity to be supplied before execution
limits: Development scenarios reuse registered loci; no independent species/genome accuracy claim
All error and biological changes are declared simulations; no new historical reconstruction
No graph evidence supplied; no platform-calibrated raw reads
No held-out access or new RagTag superiority comparison
One frozen candidate, one paired output pass, no post-score tuning or additional cycle

matching.alternative_plans: One plan is one queue item even with multiple cuts. Native plan points can contribute point-error/edge coverage and biological/clean burden; its bounding span is not an interval proposal
matching.assignment: Greedy one-to-one event/error matching sorted by summed edge distance, stable event ID, error ID; supplementary edge coverage separately credits visible native edges regardless of event type
matching.coordinates: native input, 0-based half-open; cut after position bases
matching.deduplication: Greedy deterministic representatives sorted contig, shape, start, end, ID; same point/interval endpoints or equal-length ordered cut sets within500bp deduplicate across event kind/reference frame; no transitive chaining
matching.misjoin: One point event or any explicit cut point of an alternative plan within500bp; orientation/gap intervals do not count as point proposals
matching.orientation: One interval event must match both error endpoints within500bp each; two cut/plan points do not count as one interval
matching.queue: Count pending cut and inspect proposals, including new structured events; keep acknowledgment rows reported separately, not actionable queue; merge schema details into decision IDs so no event counted twice

metrics: True-error proposal coverage: matched errors/expected; per-case and pooled, known diagnostics separate
Error edge visibility as a separate metric
Queue size, event-kind counts, pending count and acknowledgment rows
Biological-control inspection burden: number of events touching specified preservation regions and number of controls touched; not false correction
Clean-region inspection burden outside error intervals expanded500bp (including endpoint coordinate) and declared biological regions; record whole-record controls separately
Geometric redundant event count and unique geometries
Stage-loss explanation availability and reported stage/reasons; descriptive, not assumed factual accuracy
Input/stage/evidence identities, explicit per-coordinate availability, bounds/skips/omitted-event counts
Automatic output FASTA/component ledger equality per paired case/policy; unchanged provenance and complete-target scorer metrics, with already-correct controls separate from repairs

scripted_replay.interpretation: Selection/replay feasibility, not unattended correction or blinded reviewer accuracy; report residual repair errors if emitted edges are imprecise
scripted_replay.procedure: Reject other scan decisions; create explicit reverse edit linked to selected event, reviewer/scripted rationale, accept it, preview then apply, byte-exact manual recipe replay, fresh-align and validate. Explicit coordinates come from emitted event, not refined to truth.
scripted_replay.selection: Choose a matching interval event by total endpoint distance then event ID, using evaluator-known event geometry only after both review output commitments; label oracle event selection. Use the emitted interval endpoints unchanged.
scripted_replay.unavailable: Record unavailable if no matching interval; no keep-event fallback or invented interval
